checks.claim: static friction compensates net tangential drive

selectedRecords.manualArithmetic: Assigned checks: (2/5)·20=8N; (9−3)/2=3m/s². Dynamic observations may keep mg sinθ and mg cosθ symbolic; no trig lookup is required. From a valid default/reset, the actual input handler maintains 0≤μd≤μs, so departure implies |drive|>μsN≥μdN; the rejected raw-solver counterexample is outside the consumer domain. Static friction takes the needed value, not always its maximum.
selectedRecords.pedagogicalReview: Existing source/assigned-task review reused; no new student usability evidence.
selectedRecords.physicalAssumptions: Rigid plane, gravitational field constant, no normal component of applied traction; initial rest, Coulomb static bound, nonnegative kinetic coefficient no larger than static, enforced by caller. Positive tangent uphill; friction opposes departure.

selectedRecords.manualArithmetic: Assigned checks:10/10=1s;3·(6/5)=18/5m. Pilot checks:6/5−5/25=1m;10·(4/5)/2=4m/s. Arbitrary angle readouts are observations, not requests for decimal trigonometry; exact v0 sinα/cosα is sufficient. Zero elevation is a degenerate zero-flight model; the oblique-flight prediction does not assert a horizontal velocity for a vertical shot.
selectedRecords.pedagogicalReview: Existing source/assigned-task review reused; no new student usability evidence.
selectedRecords.physicalAssumptions: Point particle, uniform downward gravity, no air, launch/return at same elevation; independent horizontal components. Azimuth rotates the horizontal vector; vertical and zero-elevation limits treated separately.

selectedRecords.manualArithmetic: Assigned checks:1000·10·(1/2)=5000Pa=5kPa;16000/(800·10)=2m. Surface pressure is subtracted before inverse depth. Consumer g=981/100 is separate from the assigned g=10; use exact rational ρ(981/100)h or compare displayed readings. Pa/m is the pressure-depth slope unit.
selectedRecords.pedagogicalReview: Existing source/assigned-task review reused; no new student usability evidence.
selectedRecords.physicalAssumptions: Connected homogeneous liquid at rest, uniform surface pressure and constant gravity. Depth measured positively downward; absolute and gauge pressure separated. Equal-depth comparison is scoped to this medium.

selectedRecords.manualArithmetic: Assigned checks:32/16=2mL/s and160/16=10Pa; pilot8(1−1/4)·2=12mm and96/16=6Pa. Ratios cancel π and common parameters. General Q and hydraulic resistance remain exact symbolic π expressions; optional decimal readouts are computed observations. Reynolds warning and suspended tracer/profile distinguish an extrapolated formula from a valid developed laminar model.
selectedRecords.pedagogicalReview: Existing source/assigned-task review reused; no new student usability evidence.
selectedRecords.physicalAssumptions: Newtonian incompressible fluid, rigid straight circular tube, no-slip, stationary developed profile. Pump can fix pressure or flow; other variables held when comparing radii. Reynolds2300 is indicative; off-domain displayed values are labeled extrapolation and profile/tracers suspended.

checks.claim: model R error below display precision

selectedRecords.manualArithmetic: Assigned checks:90·4/2=180kPa and100·450/300=150kPa. Pilot60·4/3=80kPa and W=Q=+45J from ΔU=0. Ratios cancel nR, with absolute temperature. Optional isothermal work may remain nRT ln(Vf/Vi); no numerical logarithm is assigned. Model R=8.314462618 is a numerical approximation, not the exact SI product. The display uses four significant digits.
selectedRecords.pedagogicalReview: Existing source/assigned-task review reused; no new student usability evidence.
selectedRecords.physicalAssumptions: Fixed amount of ideal dilute gas, equilibrium states, positive absolute T/V/p, thermostatic quasistatic isotherm; six-second animation is a parametrization of states, not a dynamical piston law. Work sign is work by gas; no temperature change or internal-energy change on the isotherm.
